browser_request_latency.percentile_method: nearest rank; with 11 observations, p95 is the maximum

server_to_typesafe_roundtrip.percentile_method: nearest rank; with 11 observations, p95 is the maximum

method.sample: One recorded mission after one separate smoke request; smoke excluded from metrics.
method.model_input: Text game state, not camera pixels.
method.model_output: One of attack, heal, resupply, collect, extract every two simulation seconds.
method.game_motor: Shared deterministic navigation, target selection, aiming, firing and strafing.
method.capture: Live canvas recording at normal speed, including inference waits; no audio; no retries.
method.timing: Simulation pauses for inference. Browser latency includes local bridge and remote request; provider call timing includes network and service time, not pure model compute.
method.scope: One seed and different inference deployments; not a general model benchmark.
